claim_ceiling: These are expected structural and policy outcomes for synthetic test mutations. They do not prove security of a deployed service or real-world geospatial accuracy.

cases.reason: RecordID must uniquely identify a record within the declared dataset snapshot.
Multiple records may describe the same real-world object; preserve both records and their provenance.
Object identity collision requires owner reconciliation; do not infer merge or split.
SystemID is scoped to issuing provider and is not globally unique by assumption.
No geometry merge or distance comparison across incompatible frames.
A geometry claim without an uncertainty state cannot satisfy the profile.
Valid time, observed time and record time differ; latest timestamp is not a truth rule.
Withheld is an access state, not proof of asset absence.
Purpose-bound, least-privilege disclosure must be enforced by the host/owner policy.
Every observation must link to a feature of interest or explicitly retain unresolved linkage.
Missingness and epistemic state are not numeric zero.
No accepted as-built claim without exact design revision and independent acceptance evidence.
